searchables.thing: the bare wet stone beneath the gold (the real den)

rooms.desc: The gold gathers itself for one last, best lie: a high-backed chair at the head of the long table, and in it the Host — the gracious one, hands folded, smiling like he has all the time in the world and is pleased you came so far. This is the loom of the whole haven. When you raise a weapon he does not flinch — he MULTIPLIES: five of him around the table, then seven, every one identical, every one casting a shadow, every one warm, every one reflected, every one saying come, sit, you've earned it. Strike the wrong one and the others are still smiling while you bleed. And the note said it: kill it twice.
rooms.name: The Host's Seat
rooms.light: False gold thickest here (the Host is its source) through phase 1; then it DIES with the true form, leaving only Alan's Ember and the dim honest stone for phases 2-3. Light-discipline is the through-line of the back half.
rooms.exhausted: After the true form falls and the haven collapses, the seat is bare predation-den stone, the real remains of everyone it took, the drop at the lip, and the open stair. Nothing respawns; the floor is cleared.
rooms.otherExits: the real ascending stair ahead (on clearing); the den behind

searchables.use: the floor boss — STAGED (see encounters the-host-01 phase 1 + the-host-trueform-02 phase 2). PHASE 1 is the IDENTIFICATION fight: every decoy now fakes EVERY cheap tell (shadow, heat, reflection), so the plain tools are spent — the real one is found only by (a) his EMBER FLARE / salting the room with real fire, which reveals all projections at once for a turn, plus (b) the den's triangulation (the real Host loops least, displaces dust, sits truly at the head where the slope bottoms). Striking a decoy ×0.25 + the real Host counters (~67). A confirmed true-Host strike ×3 doesn't kill it — it CRACKS the haven.
searchables.note: phase 1 = the hardest read on the floor (all tells faked at once). The Ember-flare + cross-reference is the intended solve; the note ('bring your own fire', 'kill it twice') primes both.
searchables.thing: The Host (at the head of the table) and his ring of decoys

searchables.use: PHASE 2 — the ×3 true-strike doesn't end it; it tears the gracious mask off and the thing under all the faces stands up: a fast, lean predator (see the-host-trueform-02). The gold dies; the room goes to real cold stone. Now it is a STRAIGHT, dangerous fight — it acts before Alan (Init 33), hits for ~94 of his 124 HP per connect, and tries to slip into the failing shadows to re-cloak. GATE here is LIGHT-DISCIPLINE (a floor-4 callback): pinned in Alan's Ember-light it takes ×1.5 (~2 clean hits drop it); if it reaches shadow it flickers half-real at ×0.5 and re-hides. He must keep it lit and finish fast.
searchables.note: phase 2 = the difficulty ramp — a real kill-risk fight, not a puzzle. Reading won phase 1; survival + light-discipline win phase 2.
searchables.thing: the Host's TRUE FORM (revealed when the haven cracks)

searchables.use: PHASE 3 — when the true form falls, the whole illusion dies AT ONCE (the journal warned it): the gold peels away, and with it the painted-over floor — the real den's edges and the drop at the chamber's lip (hidden by the lie this whole time) are suddenly live. A brief escape beat: reach the real ascending stair (now revealed where the 'onward door' pretended to be) before the dying illusion drops the false footing. A reader who heeded the journal stays NEAR THE STAIR for the kill and steps onto solid stone as the gold falls away.
searchables.note: phase 3 = staged climax, not a third enemy: a short environmental escape compounding floor-4's falling onto floor-5's deception. Heeding the journal ('be near the stair') trivializes it; ignoring it risks a fall on the win.
searchables.thing: the failing haven / the chamber's hidden edges (PHASE 3)

floor-data.scale: FLOOR 5 IS A STEP UP IN SIZE (5 rooms vs floor 4's 3) AND COMPLEXITY (a COMPOUNDING verification ladder — each room the illusion defeats the tell that beat the last, forcing Alan up a rung of proof — plus MULTI-THREAT encounters and a STAGED multi-phase boss). See designerNotes → ESCALATION and floors/SCHEMA.md → 'Escalation mandate'. This is deliberately not the floor-4 template; the shape is varied as well as the axis.
floor-data.theme: You climb the last of the dark shaft and the Tower changes its mind about you. The cold updraft warms. The grey seam at the top opens not onto more stone but onto a long, low room lit gold — lamplight, a banked hearth, the smell of bread and woodsmoke after days of dust and grease. A table is laid down its length, plates and a steaming ewer, chairs pushed back as if a meal just paused. Couches and a made bed wait along the warm wall. By the hearth a figure rises — hooded soft, both hands open and empty, a voice like someone glad you finally made it: 'You're hurt. Come in, climber. Sit. You've earned the rest.' After floor four's killing dark, every nerve you own wants to walk in and put the weapon down. And this is only the threshold — the haven runs back and back, room after warm room, deeper than one glance can hold. (Continuity: reached by ASCENDING from floor 4's headworks. Alan ends his action on a QUIET SCOUT from the threshold — he has NOT committed inside. Resolve the scout against scoutReveal in the first room. Do NOT narrate the haven as real or safe in the System voice; the warmth and welcome are the player-facing surface only.)

enemy.name: The Welcomer
enemy.hpNote: engine: VIT8(64)+MIGHT2(18) = 82 HP. physDef (8+14)/2 = 11. physAtk 9*1.5+14+3 = 30.5. Init 13+14 = 27 (beats Alan's 26 on the trust-opener — front-load that turn). Threat = the trust-ambush, not HP.
enemy.readableTrait: A slight, cold predator wearing a kind climber's face (PRESENCE 16 / FINESSE 14 sell it; frail — 82 HP, no armor). GATE — TRUST is the danger (the social mirror of floor 4's dark). Its weapon is the WELCOME: if Alan accepts aid / sits / lets it close, it strikes intimate from full trust — coordinator: opening blow at intent 6-8 vs a flat-footed Alan (~53-70 to his 124 HP, and it presses before he recovers; not the VIT-6 near-kill the Stalker was, but brutal and spiraling if he keeps trusting). Striking the PRESENTED kind figure ×0.25 (a woven image). It is REVEALED by the TIER-2 tell — the plain shadow-tell is faked here, so use the EMBER HEAT-SHADOW (real flame shows a real body's heat-warped shadow; the glamour's is cold) — or by the mirrors deeper in; the true cold form then takes ×1.8 and his INT read of its real lunge earns intent 8+. The wrong read — taking it at its word, the flask, the seat — gets him knifed from arm's reach. It mirrors a face he WANTS to trust; a reader trusts no one the haven hands him, and refuses every comfort.

reward.drop: a false-face shard (glamour/illusion-affinity seed — woven light holding a borrowed face) and its true hide (thin, cold, light-drinking like the Stalker's lens — crafting material toward a concealing garment)

encounters.trigger: accepting the Welcomer's aid/rest in the Hall of Welcome, OR moving deeper, OR revealing/striking it

enemy.name: The Welcomers (coordinated pair — run TWO instances of this sheet)
enemy.hpNote: engine (each): VIT8(64)+MIGHT2(18) = 82 HP. physDef 11. physAtk 30.5. Init 27 each. TWO of them = the floor-5 threat step-up; the danger is the flank + the trust, not a HP wall.
enemy.readableTrait: TWO Welcomers (same sheet, run as two) working as a MULTI-THREAT pair — the genuine difficulty ramp over floor 4's lone predator. One FRONTS (holds attention with the cup/offer), one FLANKS (circles to his back 'to look at the wound') for the intimate kill; if he fixates on one, the other lands the trust-strike (~53-70). GATE: same as the lone Welcomer (presented ×0.25 / revealed true form ×1.8 / trust-opener lethal), but now the TIER-3 tell — the Ember heat-shadow is ALSO faked in the gallery, so the honest tool is the MIRRORS (woven figures throw no reflection). The read: keep his back to a mirror or wall (deny the flank — geometry beating his weak PER), catch each figure in the glass to tell real-from-projected, refuse both offers, and reveal/strike the true forms. Brute-trading in the open while flanked is a lethal slog; a reader controls the angles and uses the silver. Coordinator: the pair can be split (lure one past a mirror, isolate it) — reward that.

reward.drop: two false-face shards (a matched pair — a glamour-craft seed toward casting a borrowed face of his own) and a silvered gallery-shard (a true-reflection lens — a verification tool he can carry forward against illusion)

encounters.trigger: entering the Long Gallery / engaging either of the two figures (they act together)

enemy.name: The Host (Warden of the Haven) — Phase 1, the Weaver
enemy.hpNote: engine: VIT8(120)+MIGHT2(24) = 144 HP. physDef (15+10)/2+2 = 14.5. physAtk 12*1.5+10+4 = 32. Init 12+10 = 22 (Alan's 26 first, but worthless until he's IDed the real one). HP a wall only if you brute the decoys.
enemy.readableTrait: The loom of the false haven, 144 HP — phase 1 is IDENTIFICATION, not HP. Threatened, it SPLITS into identical decoys (5, then 7) ringing the table, and — unlike the rooms before — each decoy now fakes EVERY cheap tell at once (shadow, heat, reflection), because the haven has climbed the whole ladder with him. So the plain tools are spent. The real one is found by: (a) his EMBER FLARE / salting the room with real fire — reveals ALL projections at once for a turn (coordinator: the true-Host strike that turn is at intent +2 and UNMITIGATED), and (b) the den's triangulation (the real Host loops least, displaces dust/grit, and sits truly at the head where the floor slopes down). Striking any decoy ×0.25 (~22-25/hit on 144) AND each wrong strike the real Host lands an intimate counter (~67 to Alan's 124 — two wrong reads is near-death) and reshuffles. A confirmed true-Host strike ×3 (~299) does NOT kill it — it CRACKS the haven and triggers PHASE 2 (the note: 'kill it twice'). WILL-gate (his second-best axis, load-bearing): the haven pulls steadily to relax/trust/do-nothing; his iron WILL (mentDef 35.5) makes him resistant IF he leans on it — a reader recognizes the comfort as foreign and acts. Brute-clearing seven decoys is a counter-stacked slog that kills him first.

reward.drop: (phase 1 banks no reward on its own — the cracked haven flows directly into phase 2; reward is on the true-form kill)

encounters.trigger: raising a weapon to the Host / forcing the false exit (PHASE 1 — the decoy-weaver)

enemy.name: The Host — Phase 2, True Form
enemy.hpNote: engine: VIT8(104)+MIGHT2(26) = 130 HP. physDef (13+17)/2+1 = 16. physAtk 13*1.5+17+5 = 41.5. Init 16+17 = 33 (acts before Alan's 26 — the core of the threat). 1d20 Wild Variance = real spike risk both ways.
enemy.readableTrait: The thing under all the faces — fast and lean, 130 HP, the gracious mask gone (PRESENCE crashes to 8; FINESSE 17 / PERCEPTION 16 / Init 33 — it acts BEFORE Alan now). This is the DIFFICULTY RAMP: phase 1 was a read, phase 2 is a real, lethal fight. It hits for ~94 of Alan's 124 HP per clean connect (1d20 — swingy, crits ~5%), so TWO connects kill him and it strikes first — he cannot trade slowly. GATE is LIGHT-DISCIPLINE (a floor-4 callback, compounded): the haven is dead so there's no decoy game, but the predator tries to slip into the failing shadows to re-cloak and reset. Pinned in Alan's EMBER-LIGHT it is fully real and exposed — coordinator ×1.5 (~126/hit, ~2 clean hits drop it); if it reaches shadow it flickers half-real — coordinator ×0.5 (~42/hit) and re-hides for a beat (resetting toward another ambush). The line: keep it LIT (Burning Anger's banked core, an Ember flare, a thrown brand), corner it against real stone, and finish in two before it lands two. Aelwyn, if present, fronts it (her HP/physDef soak the ~94 blows so Alan can place the killing strikes from light) — but solo is winnable by light-discipline + his glass-cannon output.

reward.drop: the haven's ANCHOR (a 'lantern of true seeing' / revelation-core — a cold clear lens that, lit with his Ember, shows woven illusion for what it is; a strong forward counter-tool for future deception floors + a true-sight affinity seed) and the Host's mantle (the woven-light cloak — glamour-craft material / a PRESENCE-keyed deception-affinity seed)

encounters.trigger: a confirmed true-Host strike cracks the haven (PHASE 2 — the predator under the faces; flows straight from the-host-01)

floor-data.designerNotes:
FLOOR 5 — the DECEPTION / VERIFICATION floor, AND the first floor built to the whole-tower ESCALATION mandate (Alan, 2026-06-24). Two things at once: a NEW tactical axis (novelty) and a clear STEP UP in size/complexity/difficulty (magnitude). See floors/SCHEMA.md → 'Escalation mandate' for the curve this floor seeds.

NEW AXIS (novelty, continuing f1 chokepoint / f2 water / f3 acoustics / f4 dark+timing+falling): TRUST vs VERIFICATION — what Alan perceives is unreliable; the floor is solved by reasoning real-from-false and refusing comfort, not by force or noticing. The welcome IS the weapon; a deliberate tonal swerve after floor 4's killing dark.

MAGNITUDE (the new mandate — how floor 5 is bigger/harder than floor 4, not just different):
- SIZE: 5 rooms vs floor 4's 3 (threshold → hall → long gallery → deep den → host's seat).
- COMPOUNDING MECHANIC (the complexity engine): a VERIFICATION LADDER. The deception LEARNS — each room it fakes the tell that beat it in the last, forcing Alan up a rung of proof: threshold = no shadows (tell: shadow/Ember) → hall = fakes shadows (tell: Ember heat-shadow) → gallery = fakes heat (tell: mirror reflection) → den = fakes reflection (tell: cross-reference/triangulation — loop + dust + beat-late reaction) → boss = fakes everything at once (solve: Ember-FLARE reveal + triangulation). This is layered/compounding, not one static gimmick — the read gets genuinely harder as he climbs.
- MULTI-THREAT: not one warden + one gimmick. A lone Welcomer (hall), then a COORDINATED PAIR that flanks (gallery), then the staged boss. Threat ramps from single → pair → staged-multiphase.
- STAGED BOSS (3 phases): phase 1 IDENTIFICATION (read the real Host among 7 all-tells-faked decoys — the hardest read on the floor) → phase 2 TRUE-FORM FIGHT (the ×3 strike cracks, doesn't kill; a fast predator that acts first and ~94/hit nearly two-shots Alan — a real survival fight gated on LIGHT-DISCIPLINE, a floor-4 callback) → phase 3 COLLAPSE-ESCAPE (the dying haven strips the painted-over floor; reach the revealed stair before the false footing drops — floor-4 falling compounded onto floor-5 deception). 'Kill it twice' (the note) = the staged shape, fairly telegraphed.

BUILT ON ALAN'S L6 PROFILE (sheets/alan.json): PUNISHES weak PERCEPTION (passive look buys the lie — Sensitivity-not-Observance fails), REWARDS peak INTELLECT (20 — every tell reasoning-discoverable; the den is pure deduction). Two traits made load-bearing in new ways: (1) EMBER AFFINITY = the floor's lie-detector and the one tell the ladder can never fully fake (real fire stays honest), keyed to HIS build like floor 2's brazier / floor 4's lantern; (2) iron WILL (17, mentDef 35.5 — a fortress) = a DETECTION SENSE (the comfort-pull reads as foreign to a will that strong). NOTE his mentDef is too high for a mind-ATTACK floor to threaten — so the floor deliberately does NOT roll ment attacks; it lies to his senses and lures his CHOICES (eat/rest/trust), which no defense stat blocks. New boss-SHAPE too: f3 (keystone) and f4 (pawl) were 'strike the one KNOWN weak point' (placement puzzles); f5 phase 1 is an IDENTIFICATION puzzle ('which of seven identical is REAL?'), phase 2 a straight fight — varied shape, same 'reading beats brute force' spine.

DAMAGE-GATE MODEL (continued f2-4, REQUIRED): each readableTrait carries explicit gate ×M applied to baseDamage before margin-scaling. Floor 5 gates: Welcomer ×0.25 glamour / ×1.8 revealed (+ trust-ambush ~53-70); Pair same + flank pressure; Host phase-1 ×0.25 decoy (+ ~67 counter/wrong strike) / ×3 true-Host (cracks, not kills) / Ember-flare reveal = intent +2 unmitigated; Host phase-2 ×1.5 light-pinned / ×0.5 if it reaches shadow. VERIFIED EMPIRICALLY vs engine/engine.ts on the LIVE L6 sheet (physAtk 45 w/ Burning Anger, physDef 14 w/ cloak, 1d20): Host decoy ×0.25 ~22-25/hit vs 144 (slog) w/ ~67 counters; true-Host ×3 ~299 (cracks the haven); Welcomer glamour ×0.25 ~20 / true ×1.8 ~143; true-form pinned ×1.5 ~126/hit (~2 to drop 130 HP) vs shadow ×0.5 ~42; true-form INTO Alan ~94/hit vs 124 HP acting first (Init 33) — two connects kill him. The math enforces it: read + refuse comfort + light-discipline win; force-or-trust is lethal.

POWER BUDGET / DIFFICULTY: L6 with Burning Anger (atk 10, banked ember core — his own fire is always on hand, which is WHY the Ember-verification line is reliably available), Stalker cloak (physDef 14), HP 124, Focus 114, mentDef 35.5. A strong glass-cannon; the floor doesn't threaten his HP wall in the read phases (it threatens his JUDGMENT) but the phase-2 true-form genuinely CAN kill him (the ramp). Net difficulty: a clear step up from floor 4 — bigger, layered, multi-threat, and with a real-kill-risk boss phase. Built winnable SOLO; COMPANION NOTE (coordinator's call, none written in): a 'two minds see the lie' floor is a natural companion-entry beat — an ally who throws a real shadow is itself a verification anchor and fronts the true-form's ~94 blows — flagged to Alan as optional, not required.

SEQUENCING / LETHAL TRAPS: (a) TRUSTING — eat/drink/sit/sleep/accept aid: the haven feeds on a dropped guard, the Welcomers knife from arm's reach; (b) FORCING — hacking decoys/phantoms: counter-stacked slog; (c) phase-2 CARELESSNESS — trading slowly with the true form or letting it reach shadow: it two-shots him. The floor pivots on the SCOUT he just took (distrust from the threshold) and on never relaxing inward. RETREAT is open at the threshold (down to floor 4); committing inside begins the hold. LOOP NOTE (coordinator-only): layout, the ladder, searchables, and all enemy sheets are FIXED/reproducible; the held-dark loop context is iris-manager's — nothing secret is in this floor's math. NO honest water except the one scavenged midden flask; NO real rest/heal (decided contrasts — the haven only offers the APPEARANCE; do not confabulate real sustenance). REWARD PATH: a glamour seed + true-hide (Welcomer), a matched glamour pair + a true-reflection lens (the pair), and the haven's ANCHOR — a 'lantern of true seeing' that lit with his Ember unmakes illusion (a strong forward counter-tool, hooking future deception floors) + a deception/PRESENCE mantle (the Host). Feeds Equipment/Crafting, Affinities, and the still-latent social/PRESENCE axis. SCOUT-REVEAL (haven-threshold → scoutReveal) is the live deliverable; the deeper rooms/staged boss are prepped and held-dark until he commits.

LENS RULING (locked t71, 2026-06-24): looking THROUGH the Stalker eye-lenses (light-DRINKING dark-hunter eyes) at the threshold DRINKS the false gold and turns his deduced strong-read into direct SIGHT of the honest substrate (dead cold hearth, true dimness, bones plain, host-figure thinning to a HOLLOW PROJECTION — NOT the held-dark phase-2 true form). BOUNDS: threshold line-of-sight only (no seeing into deeper rooms/pair/boss); the lens is a LIGHT-SUBTRACTING tool — decisive here (the threshold lie is purely light) but NOT a master key (the deeper ladder fakes shadow/heat/reflection/behavior, which drinking light doesn't expose and can obscure). CONSEQUENCE: CLEAN, no provocation — the lens ABSORBS (a stealth organ), unlike the t57 emberlight beacon that EMITTED and drew the Stalker; don't aggro on it. Tradeoff is INSTRUMENT ANTAGONISM not threat — it drinks TRUE light too (his Ember), dimming his own lie-detector while worn and fighting Ember-flare deeper where that's the solve (self-limiting). REWARD ARC: the eye-lens is the deliberate PRECURSOR to the Host's 'lantern of true seeing' — lens = crude/passive/SUBTRACTS false light (half-blinds to true light); lantern = refined/Ember-lit/ADDS true sight with no blindness cost. Kept distinct.

GRAPPLE/TETHER RULING (locked t72, 2026-06-24): throwing a chain-tether from the threshold to drag the haven's furniture out without entering — PHYSICS INVARIANT (lens-independent): the hook passes THROUGH the glamour-feast (light, not matter) and catches only the REAL substrate beneath (the charnel bones); host-image never reacts. GEOGRAPHY: only the NEAR end of the table/charnel is within tether reach of the threshold-stone; hearth/host's-seat/deeper hall are SET DEEP, beyond any throw without a step in — depth requires committing, the grapple is a threshold-edge salvage tool, never a strip-from-outside exploit. THREAT: CLEAN while he stays planted — the floor does NOT contest the tether (the predator won't blow its ambush over a chain at the door; the haven wants him to COME IN). Instead the ILLUSION DOUBLES DOWN as he hauls truth out (welcome warms, host more insistent, gold re-drapes the gap) — lying harder to lure, NOT a grab/threat-state change. ARMED BOUND: the grab/reel becomes a live fair consequence ONLY if HE crosses the plane (leans/commits his body past the threshold for reach, or anchors himself to the chain) — the line is the rule. LOOT (bounded): grim real climber bones (physical proof) + ONE modest tangible (pitted iron spike / broken blade, minor atk ~2-3 / cold-iron forge stock); kept small so threshold salvage doesn't pre-empt the deeper reward path; no second warning-note (the hall's corpse-note is the lore-gate); the near-pile is EXHAUSTIBLE (a few tries strips reachable substrate, then more wants a step in). Mechanics: weld = routine Smithing (modest ember/focus draw, core spent-low since t68); throw-and-catch = improvised 1d20 FINESSE, low DC vs the stationary near-pile, 'many tries' = success assured, rolls set speed/quality.
